ApiFramework.description: The codes of AdCOM 1.0 List: API Frameworks (https://github.com/InteractiveAdvertisingBureau/AdCOM/blob/26c59ba1b235cd8d938c9877409e506f1b8d3f0c/AdCOM%20v1.0%20FINAL.md#list_apiframeworks); `1`: VPAID 1.0; `2`: VPAID 2.0; `3`: MRAID 1.0; `4`: ORMMA; `5`: MRAID 2.0; `6`: MRAID 3.0; `7`: OMID 1.0; `8`: SIMID 1.0; `9`: SIMID 1.1; from 500 up: Vendor-specific codes

domain.description: Developer domain, against which `app-ads.txt` is checked. As `app.domain`

platform.description: `ios` | `android` | `roku` | `fire_tv` | `samsung_tv` and other store platforms. No OpenRTB equivalent

ContentDetail.description: The shows, series, sections, and network verticals the line item's inventory holds. The specification states no members, so the object accepts any.

EnvironmentsSelection.description: A field the buyer sets by choosing options from the set the seller declares. `included[]` names the options in the base rate, and `pricing` gives the change in price for each other option.

included.description: The options in the base rate, each named as `available[]` holds it: a string option by its value, and an object option by its `id`, the identity the seller mints for it.

pricing.description: The change in price of each option beyond those included, keyed by the option's name: a string option's value, or an object option's `id`, the identity the seller mints for it.

api.description: Values from List: API Frameworks that every impression supports, such as MRAID 3.0 (6), OMID 1.0 (7) and SIMID 1.1 (9)

instl.description: `0` (no) | `1` (yes). The ad is interstitial or full screen

playmethod.description: Video or audio. Values from List: Playback Methods in use, such as Initiates without any specific user interaction with Sound On (1), Initiates without any specific user interaction Sound Off by Default (2), Initiates on Click with Sound On (3) and Continuous Playback (7)

plcmt.description: One value from List: Plcmt Subtypes - Video: Instream (1), Accompanying Content (2), Interstitial (3), No Content/Standalone (4), Pause (5), Screensaver (6), Overlay (7), Squeezeback (8), In-scene (9)

refresh.description: `{ min_interval_s }`: minimum seconds a creative renders before the slot refreshes

reward.description: `0` (no) | `1` (yes). The user receives a reward for viewing the ad

skip.description: Video or audio. `0` (no) | `1` (yes). The placement lets the user skip the ad

skipafter.description: When `skip` is `1`: seconds the ad plays before the placement enables skipping

PlaybackMethod.description: The codes of AdCOM 1.0 List: Playback Methods (https://github.com/InteractiveAdvertisingBureau/AdCOM/blob/26c59ba1b235cd8d938c9877409e506f1b8d3f0c/AdCOM%20v1.0%20FINAL.md#list_playbackmethods); `1`: Initiates without any specific user interaction with Sound On; `2`: Initiates without any specific user interaction Sound Off by Default; `3`: Initiates on Click with Sound On; `4`: Initiates on Mouse-Over or cursor over with Sound On; `5`: Initiates on Entering Viewport or scrolling into view with Sound On; `6`: Initiates on Entering Viewport or scrolling into view with Sound Off by Default; `7`: Continuous Playback - Media playback is set to play additional media automatically without user interaction. The media player will keep playing additional media (playlist or generated) for the user until the user actively stops this from happening.; `8`: Initiated by user pausing content, Sound on; `9`: Initiated by user pausing content, Sound off; `10`: Initiated by idling (e.g. screensaver), Sound on; `11`: Initiated by idling (e.g. screensaver), Sound off

PlcmtSubtype.description: The codes of AdCOM 1.0 List: Plcmt Subtypes - Video (https://github.com/InteractiveAdvertisingBureau/AdCOM/blob/26c59ba1b235cd8d938c9877409e506f1b8d3f0c/AdCOM%20v1.0%20FINAL.md#list_plcmtsubtypesvideo); `1`: Instream; `2`: Accompanying Content; `3`: Interstitial; `4`: No Content/Standalone; `5`: Pause; `6`: Screensaver; `7`: Overlay; `8`: Squeezeback; `9`: In-scene

id.description: The identity the seller mints for the option, which `included[]` and the `pricing` keys name it by.

PropertiesOptionOrCatalogRef.description: A value given inline, or a reference to the seller's catalog entry that holds it, never both.

PropertiesSelection.description: A field the buyer sets by choosing options from the set the seller declares. `included[]` names the options in the base rate, and `pricing` gives the change in price for each other option.

included.description: The options in the base rate, each named as `available[]` holds it: a string option by its value, and an object option by its `id`, the identity the seller mints for it.

pricing.description: The change in price of each option beyond those included, keyed by the option's name: a string option's value, or an object option's `id`, the identity the seller mints for it.

description: The OpenProposal `inventory` module: the vocabularies, objects, unions, and constructor copies of § 5.2, § 5.2.1, and § 5.2.2.
